name: Bloodbound Origins
source:
The first years after becoming a vampire are the most challenging. Find out what your friends were up to right after they were Turned.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Bloodbound_Origins]Choices Wikia[/url]]
